title: Pudhu Pettai
desc: A young boy runs away when his mother dies and ends up in the company of a gangster. He soon becomes the right-hand man of his employer and makes dangerous enemies.

title: Arima Nambi
desc: Anamika gets mysteriously abducted while on a date with Arjun. However, when Arjun goes to the police for help, he lands in a dangerous situation.

title: Kadhalum Kadanthu Pogum
desc: When a rugged thug with a hidden gentle side meets his newly single, IT consultant neighbour, an improbable romance blossoms against all odds.

title: Adhibar
desc: Shiva arrives in Chennai from Canada and starts up a real estate business. However, things take a turn when he realises that he is being cheated by the people he trusts.

title: Bhooloham
desc: Boologam and Arumugam are two famous boxers whose families are arch-rivals. Taking this into consideration, Deepak, a businessman, hatches a plan to use their rivalry to his advantage.
